headline: Rajpeta Kasturi Hanumenthareddy files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for Kavveri Defence substantial acquisition
sum: Rajpeta Kasturi Hanumenthareddy has filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code for a substantial acquisition in Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies Limited. The filing was submitted to NSE on 19 June 2026.
detail: The disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 indicates that Rajpeta Kasturi Hanumenthareddy has either crossed or intends to cross the 25% substantial holding threshold in Kavveri Defence. The filing was made public via NSE archives on 19 June 2026.
